channel.title: Alabama News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Former CNN host Don Lemon arrested in connection to Minnesota church protest
item.description: Former CNN host Don Lemon and three other people have been arrested in connection with an anti-immigration enforcement protest that disrupted a service at a Minnesota church and increased tensions between residents and federal officials.

item.title: U.S. Justice Department releasing three million pages from its Jeffrey Epstein files
item.description: The U.S. Justice Department has released many more records from its investigative files on Jeffrey Epstein, resuming disclosures under a law intended to reveal what the government knew about the millionaire financier’s sexual abuse of young girls and his interactions with the rich and powerful.

item.title: Third-grade student accused of shooting Elmore County school bus with BB gun
item.description: The Elmore County Board of Education and other authorities are investigating a report that a third-grade student shot a school bus with a BB gun.

item.title: Catherine O’Hara, Emmy-winning comedian of ‘Schitt’s Creek’ and ‘Home Alone’ fame, dies at 71
item.description: The Canadian-born O'Hara died at her home in Los Angeles “following a brief illness."

item.title: What to know about the partial federal government shutdown and its impact
item.description: The partial federal government shutdown that is in effect is vastly different from the record closure in the fall. That is mostly because the shutdown may not last long.

item.title: Six arrested in Macon County in prison contraband, narcotics investigations
item.description: Six people are under arrest in Macon County after an investigation into prison contraband and narcotics distribution.

item.title: Teenager killed in pickup truck crash in Marengo County
item.description: A teenager has been killed after crashing a pickup truck in Marengo County.

item.title: Troy university honors alumnus and trustee John Harrison
item.description: Dozens gathered at Trojan Arena to honor alumnus John Harrison and dedicate their practice facility to him.

item.title: Bitter Cold Air Lingers Into Early Monday
item.description: Another bitter cold night ahead with temps plunging into the mid to upper temps for lows. Gusty northwest winds will produce wind chills in the single digits.

item.title: LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier leads two scoring drives as American beats National 17-9 in Senior Bowl
item.description: LSU quarterback Garrett Nussmeier led a pair of touchdown drives, including a keeper for a score, as the American team beat the National team 17-9 in the Senior Bowl in Mobile today.
